items.hook: The uptick rule is a trading restriction that states that short selling a stock is allowed only on an uptick.
items.body: For the rule to be satisfied, the short must be either at a price above the last traded price of the security, or at the last traded price when the most recent movement between traded prices was upward. The world is stranger than it lets on.
